result:
**Why it happened:** The user picker in the stock user-role-scope form loaded users with one plain request to the core `/user` REST resource and never paged or searched. So only the first page the REST module returns by default was ever in the list. Any user beyond that page could not be found, and so could not be given location-scoped stock permissions.

- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-lookups/stock-lookups.resource.ts:151-164` (`useUsers`) builds `${restBaseUrl}/user` from whatever filter it is given.
- Before the fix, the form called `useUsers({ v: ResourceRepresentation.Default })` with no `limit`, `startIndex` or `q`, so the request got the REST default page only.

**What fixed it:** PR #567, "(fix) O3-4518: Stock management ESM: Unable to add user role scope on systems with many users", ticket O3-4518. It was merged on 2026-07-06. Its merge commit is `3c071999ea6f2b75706d5ba602caeba07ec55a02`, but that commit's subject reads "(chore) Update OpenMRS dependencies (#566) (#567)", so the PR is the easier thing to find. The change is in `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-user-role-scopes/add-stock-user-scope/add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx`:

- `add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx:93-98` now uses `useSearchUser()` and a debounced `setSearchString`. The user list is queried server-side with `q`, so every account can be found by name.
- `add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx:85` loads the selected user by uuid with `useUser(selectedUserUuid)`.
- The PR says it follows the same pattern as `UsersSelector` (`openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-operations/stock-operations-forms/input-components/users-selector.component.tsx`).
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-operations/stock-operations-forms/hooks/useSearchUser.ts:9-16` supplies the search hook, with `limit: 10` and a `q` filter that goes through `useUsers`.

**Related history, not the fix:**
- Commit `a23eb53452099c74cea9629e0b3a62722a9edfd4` (PR #133, March 2024, "user roles aren't showing all users in the event users are more the default rest page size") was an earlier attempt at the same symptom. Its diff removes a debounced search that called the `useUsers` hook inside a callback, which could not run a request. It also fixes the `useUser` URL, which was missing a `/`. That commit has no ticket, and PR #133 is not in Falkon, so I could not confirm a ticket for it.
- Commit `9433422866fe821429cbde6abd49fd8e07bc4d8a` (PR #130) added the filter-in-search behaviour that `useSearchUser` later reused.
- The REST module, `openmrs-module-stockmanagement`, is not involved. The paging came from the core `/user` resource, which the app calls directly.

I did not confirm the exact default page size of the core `/user` resource; the explanation relies on the PR and the code above.
